title: criterion-verification-map input contract
description: Input contract for the criterion-verification-map skill. The skill receives the parsed acceptance criteria (extracted from the issue body in commands/start.md Phase 1) and produces, per criterion, a runnable verification command and the expected evidence shape. See plugins/flow/skills/criterion-verification-map/SKILL.md for the skill's full process.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Parsed acceptance criteria from the issue body. Each criterion has the user-visible text and (optionally) a pre-classified type if commands/start.md was able to infer it.

text.description: The verbatim criterion text from the issue body. Must be at least 5 characters — anything shorter is almost certainly a parsing artifact, not a real criterion.

type.description: Optional pre-classification. The skill assigns this if the caller didn't.

issueNumber.description: Optional issue number for context. The skill uses it to construct journal paths but does not require it.
